rationale: Both Shawn and Sina are building in robotics, but with complementary focuses: Shawn's Addition Robotics works on robotic manipulation while Sina's Tuurny applies computer vision and robotics to precision component recovery from e-waste. As a co-founder judge and a founder actively raising to expand engineering, they could exchange perspectives on scaling robotics systems and potentially explore how manipulation expertise might enhance Tuurny's autonomous harvesting capabilities.
intro_message: Shawn, meet Sina Ghashghaei—founder of Tuurny, a robotics company using computer vision and automation to recover high-value components from e-waste. Given your robotics-manipulation background, you two should connect on scaling approaches and technical challenges.
